sample_unit: eyes (internal dataset; 963 eyes in external validation)

links.outcome: Progression prediction AUROC of multimodal versus conventional ML and unimodal models on same data
links.effect: Multimodal AS-OCT, Placido and tabular model gave best single-visit AUROC 0.84 (95% CI 0.83-0.85); adding sequential visits via LSTM raised it to 0.93 (95% CI 0.91-0.96).
links.quote: The multimodal model of AS-OCT, Placido, and tabular data yielded the best single-visit prediction (AUROC 0.84, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.83-0.85); adding sequential visits via long short-term memory boosted this to 0.93 (95% CI: 0.91-0.96).

unlisted_practices: Simulated risk-stratified triage pathways to reduce unnecessary follow-up for low-risk patients

screen.reason: Retrospective development and external validation of multimodal deep learning for keratoconus progression risk stratification, including a simulated triage pathway evaluation, but without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
